strapiBlog.title: Step Into Luxury: Armani Beach Residences Open For Sale
strapiBlog.short_description: Arada new project, Armani Beach Residence, is out for sale, and the master developer has begun collecting EOIs (Expression of interest) for the property. The venture results from a partnership between Arada and the iconic Italian fashion brand Armani.

data.text:
Arada’s new project, Armani Beach Residence, is out for sale, and the master developer has begun collecting EOIs (Expression of interest) for the property. The venture results from a partnership between Arada and Armani. The iconic Italian fashion brand introduced this opulent residential project in Palm Jumeirah in May 2023. Developed under the banner of Armani/Casa Interior Design Studio, the residence offers luxury apartments and penthouses. Here are all the details about the highly anticipated development.

Highlights Of Armani Beach Residences 

Arada's new project, a masterpiece and the first and last residential collaboration between Tadao Ando and Giorgio Armani offers an unparalleled living experience. Tadao Ando is a globally acclaimed Japanese architect who designed the building with his signature style of utilizing natural light and the contours of the surrounding landscape. Armani Beach Residences Palm Jumeirah by Arada is set to be completed by the end of 2026 and includes a range of exclusive amenities.

The project boasts three swimming pools, including a kid-friendly option on the ground floor, along with a private beach and various water features. For wellness and leisure, residents have access to a two-story gym and spa, complemented by 24-hour valet parking available for both residents and visitors.

The development presents 53 impeccably designed boutique residences, ranging from 2 to 5-bedroom apartments and penthouses, alongside two ultra-modern presidential suites on the top floor, which also provide access to the roof.

Each residence features a private entrance and a terrace, offering stunning views of the private beach, Burj Al Arab, and other attractions, depending on the unit's placement. Residents also have the unique opportunity to personalize their homes with a choice of light or dark color themes.

The Location Of Arada New Project

Armani Beach Residence is strategically located in Palm Jumeirah, the iconic man-made island that houses an array of popular attractions and luxury residences. Thanks to its perfect location, Armani Beach Residence will offer residents stunning views of the city's skyline and the azure waters of the Gulf.

About The Developers

Founded by Giorgio Armani, the Armani Group is one of the biggest fashion houses in the world. Headquartered in Milan, Armani has created many popular fashion and luxury goods brands. Teaming up with Emaar Properties, the brand has embarked on creating distinctive residential and hospitality properties, such as Armani Hotel Dubai, situated in the iconic Burj Khalifa and now the Armani Beach Residence.

On the other hand, Arada is a renowned name in the Sharjah real estate market. The master developer broadened its footprint in Dubai through initiatives such as Aljada and Masaar. The development of Armani Beach Residence Palm Jumeirah will further solidify Arada’s position in the emirate’s property market.

Anticipated is a sustained collaboration between the two giants, yielding more luxurious creations that will reshape the real estate landscape of the UAE.


ARADA TO CONTINUE EXPANSION IN DUBAI


The Sharjah-based developer doubled its sales in 2023, reaching AED 7 billion, compared to AED 3.5 billion the previous year. After the recent sales launch of Armani Beach Residences, Arada's Chief Executive, Ahmed Alkhoshaibi, has revealed plans to secure more plots in Dubai to launch new luxury projects.
